summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for The Editorial Wire. 45/45 pytest backend tests pass (auth, articles, comments, weather, payments mock, admin RBAC, staff articles RBAC, push). Frontend E2E via Playwright: home masthead+ticker+weather+AQI+forecast+dark-mode all working; category listings and article details load; guest comments post live; metered paywall triggers on 4th article with plans+login modal buttons; mock Razorpay checkout completes and lands on /account with Active subscription + invoices + PDF download button; RBAC verified for admin (7 tabs), editor (3 tabs), reporter (Articles only, submit-review-btn without publish-btn), and reader (redirected to /403 with forbidden-page). GST breakdown correct: West Bengal splits CGST+SGST, other states use IGST 18%. Admin push broadcast succeeds (sent 0 as expected, no subscribers).

issues: /api/auth/me returns 401 for guests on every page load and shows as console error; consider suppressing 401 log or short-circuit request when no ew_token exists in localStorage. Purely cosmetic - no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext calls /auth/me on mount for guests; add guard `if (!localStorage.getItem('ew_token')) { setUser(false); setReady(true); return; }` to avoid 401 noise in console.
payments_routes._create_invoice uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%d %b %Y') for the invoice date - date should also be user-local IST if the account UI already displays IST. Minor.
auth_routes login_attempts lockout has no time-window expiry - once a user hits 5 fails they're locked forever unless a successful login clears the counter. Consider adding TTL/reset window.
content_routes PROFANITY list includes mild words ('damn','hell','stupid','idiot') that also match substrings (e.g. 'damned', 'shell', 'stupidly'). Consider word-boundary regex.
test_credentials: Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - all 4 accounts (admin/editor/reporter/reader) verified working.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend seed on startup creates the 4 role accounts and sample articles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers 45 tests across health, auth (all 4 roles + register + invalid + brute-force awareness), articles CRUD & RBAC (reporter draft->submit, editor publish, reader forbidden), comments (guest, profanity->hidden, threading, upvote), weather (ip + city), payments MOCK (plans, create-order WB/CGST+SGST, non-WB/IGST, verify, invoice PDF, cancel), admin (users/comments/audit/invoices/gst-export/stats + RBAC forbidden matrix), and push (VAPID key, broadcast, forbidden). Run with: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. All data-testids referenced in the review request exist and were verified via Playwright.
rca_of_the_issue: No issues found - implementation is functional across all requested surfaces.
